description: Every KnowBe4 KMSAT reporting feature, plus a local SQLite store for the questions the console cannot answer.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Get account and subscription data (name, subscription level, seats, admins, current risk score). Returns the Account.

tools.name: account_risk-score-history
tools.description: Get the org-level risk-score history time series. Optional: full. Returns array of RiskScorePoint.

params.name: full
params.description: Set 'true' to return the full history (default returns the most recent points)

tools.name: groups_get
tools.description: Get a single group by id. Required: id. Returns the Group.

tools.name: groups_list
tools.description: List all groups with member counts and risk scores. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100), status. Returns array of Group.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status: active or archived

tools.name: groups_members
tools.description: List the users in a group. Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of User.

tools.name: groups_risk-score-history
tools.description: Get a group's risk-score history time series. Required: id. Optional: full. Returns array of RiskScorePoint.

params.name: full
params.description: Set 'true' to return the full history

tools.name: phishing-campaigns_get
tools.description: Get a single phishing campaign by id. Required: id. Returns the PhishingCampaign.

tools.name: phishing-campaigns_list
tools.description: List all phishing campaigns. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of PhishingCampaign.

tools.name: phishing-campaigns_security-tests
tools.description: List the phishing security tests (PSTs) run by a campaign. Required: id. Returns array of PhishingSecurityTest.

tools.name: phishing-tests_get
tools.description: Get a single phishing security test by id. Required: id. Returns the PhishingSecurityTest.

tools.name: phishing-tests_list
tools.description: List all phishing security tests (PSTs) across every campaign. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of PhishingSecurityTest.

tools.name: phishing-tests_recipient
tools.description: Get a single recipient's result within a PST. Required: pst-id, recipient-id. Returns the PstRecipient.

tools.name: phishing-tests_recipients
tools.description: List per-user results for a PST (who opened, clicked, reported, entered data). Required: id. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of PstRecipient.

tools.name: policies_get
tools.description: Get a single policy by id. Required: id. Returns the Policy.

tools.name: policies_list
tools.description: List all uploaded policies. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Policy.

tools.name: store-purchases_get
tools.description: Get a single store purchase by id. Required: id. Returns the StorePurchase.

tools.name: store-purchases_list
tools.description: List all training store purchases (licensed content/modules). Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of StorePurchase.

tools.name: training-campaigns_get
tools.description: Get a single training campaign by id. Required: id. Returns the TrainingCampaign.

tools.name: training-campaigns_list
tools.description: List all training campaigns. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of TrainingCampaign.

tools.name: training-enrollments_get
tools.description: Get a single training enrollment by id. Required: id. Returns the TrainingEnrollment.

tools.name: training-enrollments_list
tools.description: List all training enrollments with completion status and time spent. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100), campaign-id (plus 1 more). Returns array of TrainingEnrollment.

params.name: campaign-id
params.description: Only enrollments in this training campaign

params.name: store-purchase-id
params.description: Only enrollments for this store purchase / module

tools.name: users_get
tools.description: Get a single user by id. Required: id. Returns the User.

tools.name: users_list
tools.description: List all users with risk score and phish-prone percentage. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100), status (plus 1 more). Returns array of User.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status: active or archived

params.name: group-id
params.description: Only users in this group id

tools.name: users_risk-score-history
tools.description: Get a user's risk-score history time series. Required: id. Optional: full. Returns array of RiskScorePoint.

params.name: full
params.description: Set 'true' to return the full history

novel_features.name: Repeat clickers across PSTs
novel_features.description: Surface users who clicked the bait in two or more distinct phishing security tests within a window — your hardest-to-train humans.

novel_features.name: Risk drift over time
novel_features.description: Rank users and groups by how much their risk score worsened (or improved) between a prior snapshot and now.

novel_features.name: Untrained clickers
novel_features.description: Anti-join: users who clicked a phish but have no Passed training enrollment to show for it.

novel_features.name: Coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Find active users enrolled in zero phishing campaigns or zero training campaigns — the people your program silently misses.

novel_features.name: Phish-prone trend
novel_features.description: Plot a group's phish-prone percentage across sequential phishing tests to show whether training is actually working.

novel_features.name: Risk leaderboard
novel_features.description: Highest-risk users ranked, each enriched with click history, report rate, and overdue-training context.

novel_features.name: Group risk contribution
novel_features.description: Attribute account-level risk movement to the specific groups (departments) driving it up or down.

novel_features.name: Client QBR pack
novel_features.description: One command that assembles the full quarterly review: risk trend, phish-prone trend, training completion, and the top-risk humans.

novel_features.name: Report-vs-click leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank users and groups by how often they report simulated phish versus falling for them - surfacing who never uses the Phish Alert Button.

novel_features.name: Sync freshness / input-readiness
novel_features.description: See per-table sync freshness and whether the cross-entity commands have the data they need - before trusting a clicker hunt.
